analysis:
Examined the work-disk additions. SandboxAddon.swift head 154-173 and 211-225 parse an optional `disks` array from the add-on's `status --json`. Each entry yields path, root_volume, state, detail, free_bytes and slot totals; slot totals are clamped to >=0, and malformed entries are dropped through compactMap. `supportsWorkDisks` is set only when `disks` is present. The add-on is already a trusted, same-owner component under TB-013/T-061, and this is display parsing only. It adds no new process execution or path use: the binary path is unchanged (lines 14, 56).

SandboxEligibility.swift head 247-262 appends info-level "Work disk" check lines per plan disk, using gibDown on freeBytes/floorBytes. slotLine was refactored into jobCount (312-319) with no behavior change. The `disks` property and `floorBytes` of SandboxSizingPlan are defined outside the supplied source. Their parsing from installer output is not visible and needs integration confirmation. This is display only; no authorization or eligibility decision depends on it.

docs/provider/sandboxes.md 61-99 documents `--disk` and the offer to run `sudo diskutil enableOwnership`. With `--yes` or without a terminal, the doc says setup only prints the command and stops. The setup implementation that builds and runs that sudo command is not in this batch. Integration should verify that it passes the volume path as a discrete argv element rather than through a shell, and that it requires an interactive prompt. That runs as the owner with the owner's own consent (A-019, TB-013), so no privilege boundary is crossed.

The external drives are sandbox VM storage, not the prefix cache. T-041's cache-storage controls are unaffected. No regression to provider inference, keys, attestation or hold-socket (TB-012) behavior was identified.
